Unresolved substep transients and the entry transition before both first inserted samples are excluded. Rejected coupling-trial force diagnostics are excluded.

force_law_assessment.scope: Task checks assess the selected insertion scenarios. Force/moment residuals assess endpoint force-law scatter, not every finite-tolerance applied iterate. Applied-load balance is covered independently by coupler regression tests. Sparse post-entry force-vector comparisons are observations without an acceptance threshold. Passing task checks does not establish convergence of full force histories or coupled energy.

provenance.reproduction_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run --locked --extra examples python tools/validate_needle_insertion.py --device cuda:0 --output docs/validation/needle-insertion.json
provenance.run_note: Cases were run in separate fresh processes using the validator, with a diagnostic-only wrapper that saves failed-step checkpoints. The combined checks were computed from those saved cases without rerunning or changing thresholds.
